reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing shared policy getMonthBudgetCategories/shouldIncludeMonthBudgetCategory instead of filtering at each action.

duplication.why: The hidden rule changes once in shouldIncludeMonthBudgetCategory; the only repetition is the identical argument plumbing at each action.

placement.why: The rule change sits in month-action-categories.ts, the module the tree uses for the month-wide category policy.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions' signatures and the shared policy are touched.

maintainability.why: Appending a fourth positional boolean after the optional previousMonth forces `undefined` placeholders at five call sites; an options object would read better; no tests cover the new flag.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action passes includeHiddenCategories to the shared policy; none filters hidden on its own.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the rule is edited in the one shared predicate.
